## A complete contract management solution

[Workflows](https://www.spotdraft.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-0) [Negotiation & Collaboration](https://www.spotdraft.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-1) [Management](https://www.spotdraft.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-2) [Analytics](https://www.spotdraft.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-3) [ESignatures](https://www.spotdraft.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-4)

### Take control of your contract process

Move contracts from draft to signature without endless email chains. Set conditional templates, automate approvals, and track progress at every step.

[Learn more](https://www.spotdraft.com/products/contract-creation)

![Workflow diagram showing Master Service Agreement initiation, questionnaire for Acme Corp and Globex Inc, and approval requirements based on deal amount under or over $500,000, needing Head of Finance or CFO and CEO approval respectively.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/67f4a563c41b068675434ad5_workflow%20%26%20%20approvals.avif)

### Negotiate smarter, together

SpotDraft gives Legal and Business teams a shared space to review, redline, and finalize contracts—whether in Word, Slack, or within SpotDraft.

[Learn more](https://www.spotdraft.com/products/contract-collaboration)

![Collaborative edit on Acme Service Agreement where 'not' is deleted before 'auto-renew,' Noah Johnson's annotation, Amy Miller asked to review, and approval comment saying 'Looks good, approved!'](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/67f4aeb909beda2bb5fb98b8_negotiate%2C%20collab%20(1).avif)

### Keep every contract in one secure hub

SpotDraft consolidates all your contracts in a single repository with powerful search and precise access controls.

[Learn more](https://www.spotdraft.com/products/contract-management)

![Contract management table showing contracts with automatically renew matches and expiration dates in June 2025.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/67f4b1b7348c964216d4c243_manage%20(1).avif)

### Make data-driven decisions at every stage

SpotDraft surfaces actionable insights about your contracting processes —renewals, bottlenecks, team workloads, and more.

[Learn more](https://www.spotdraft.com/products/contract-analytics)

![Bar chart showing average time taken for vendor contract approvals: Finance takes longest at about 4 days, Commercial about 2 days, and Legal shortest. Text notes finance approvals take 7 days longer and a comment suggests requiring finance approval only for amounts exceeding $15,000.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/67f4a5b2c82dda32c0bf0c7c_analytics.avif)

### Complete every contract with secure digital signatures

SpotDraft lets you send, sign, and store contracts in one place—fully compliant with major global standards like ESIGN and EIDAS.

[Learn more](https://www.spotdraft.com/products/esignatures)
